## Central Limit Theorem Simulator

See how repeated random samples produce a sampling distribution of the sample mean. Choose a population or draw your own, then explore how sample size changes the distribution of means.

[Open the Central Limit Theorem Simulator](central-limit-theorem/index.qmd)

## Sampling Distribution Simulator

Explore how the mean, median, histogram-based mode, and two variance estimators vary across repeated random samples. Choose a population or draw your own.

[Open the Sampling Distribution Simulator](sampling-distributions/index.qmd)

## Global debt flows

Visualise foreign ownership of government bonds using IMF's CPIS data. This Shiny app is written in R.

[Open the Shiny app](https://sebin-b-nidhiri.shinyapps.io/CPIS_GG_App/) · [Source code](https://github.com/sebinbn/CPIS_GGApp)
:::
